description: The Candle Daddy returns with NEW Candle Scent Melts! Our coffee scented wax cubes offer the great scent of coffee without the need for a candle! Just place in your favorite electric, light bulb, or tea light wax warmer for a long-lasting coffee scent! Enjoy the great scent of coffee anytime, anywhere, with the help of The Candle Daddy's Cofffee Wax Melts. Simply add the wax warmers to the wax warmer, and turn on for an amazing scent that fills your home or office! Each batch is hand-poured in Indiana, ensuring quality every time!
